name: personHashedUrl
label: Person URL
help: Public or hashed LinkedIn person URL, including /in/... and /sales/lead/... or an alert subject URL.

name: listId
label: List ID
help: ID of one of your lead lists to also add the lead to. Find it in the Retrieve Lists output or at the end of the list's URL. Leave empty to only save the lead. With more than 10 lead lists, a list that Sales Navigator's menu hides cannot be used and the module fails.
